title: refactor(typescript): migrate lib files
body: This migrates some lib files to TypeScript and add typings for Algolia hits.

comments.body:
Deploy preview for *instantsearchjs* ready!

Built with commit d551209ae664e717685ef7d43150d83c716f679c

https://deploy-preview-3649--instantsearchjs.netlify.com

I experimented with the following rule but it turns out to be very annoying in certain situations. Even though the types are declared in interfaces, we need to rewrite them every time. IMO we shouldn't go with this rule for now.

```
"typedef": [true, "call-signature", "property-declaration"]
```
I updated this PR so that it reflects only changes in the lib files.
